title: 第十九章 瘴行
content_zh:
偏离了熟悉的小径，山林的面目骤然变得陌生而险恶。

    脚下不再是相对平坦的、被踩实的泥土路，而是盘根错节的树根，湿滑的苔藓，和深可及膝的、堆积了不知多少年的腐叶。每一步都需要格外小心，尤其是陈默左臂不便，身体平衡受到影响，行走起来更是艰难。苏芸走在他前面几步，身姿依旧轻盈，似乎对这些难行的地势习以为常，偶尔在陈默脚步趔趄或需要攀越障碍时，会停下来，用目光或一个简单的手势示意。

    空气中那股混合着草木、泥土、露水的清新气息，渐渐被一种更深沉、更驳杂的气味所取代。那是浓郁的、带着甜腻腐朽感的腐烂植物气息，混合着一股若有若无的、令人胸口发闷的土腥和……某种难以言喻的、类似于硫磺却又更阴湿的怪味。光线也变得更加幽暗，高大树木的树冠几乎完全遮蔽了天空，只有偶尔从极其稀疏的枝叶缝隙中，漏下几缕惨淡的、有气无力的天光，非但未能照亮前路，反而让林间的幽暗与光斑形成的反差更加诡谲。

    是瘴气。陈默心里一沉。虽然极其稀薄，远未到能致命或致幻的程度，但仅仅是呼吸着这种空气，都让他感到有些气短，体内那缕好不容易恢复些许的暖流，似乎也受到了压制，运行变得滞涩。左肩的伤处，在这种湿冷污浊的空气刺激下，也开始隐隐作痛。

    “跟紧，莫要随意触碰周围植物，尤其颜色艳丽者。”苏芸的声音从前方传来，比平日更低沉了些，似乎也受到了环境影响，“此地已近黑风涧外围，瘴气初生，多有毒虫蛇蚁潜伏。收敛气息，莫要大声。”

    陈默依言，努力调整呼吸，试图让自己与周围令人不适的环境达成某种平衡。他想起苏芸所授的呼吸法，那套法门似乎有“和”与“养”的特性，或许能稍作抵御。他尝试着运转，果然，随着呼吸节奏的调整，吸入体内那污浊空气带来的滞闷感减轻了一丝，心神也略微安定。但效果有限，毕竟此法重在温养调和，而非对抗外邪。

    苏芸似乎察觉到了他气息的变化，回头看了他一眼，眼中掠过一丝几不可察的了然，但并未说什么，只是脚下更快了些。

    地势开始向下倾斜，他们似乎正在进入一个山谷地带。林木渐渐稀疏，取而代之的是大片大片的、颜色暗沉发黑的蕨类植物和潮湿的、滑腻腻的苔藓岩石。那股硫磺混合腐朽的怪味更浓了，空气也更加湿重，每一次呼吸都仿佛要吸入黏稠的水汽。偶尔能看到一些颜色鲜艳、形态奇异的蘑菇和菌类，在幽暗的光线下散发着不祥的光泽。苏芸总是远远避开，陈默也记着她的告诫，目不斜视。

    忽然，走在前面的苏芸脚步一顿，抬起手，示意陈默停下。她侧耳倾听，目光锐利地扫向前方一片被浓密藤蔓遮掩的岩壁。

    陈默也立刻停下，屏住呼吸，右手不自觉地摸向背后的柴刀刀柄。体内暖流微微加速，凝神感知。除了风吹过藤蔓的沙沙声，和远处隐约的、类似水流冲刷的闷响，似乎并无异常。

    但苏芸的表情却凝重起来。她指了指自己脚下，又指了指前方岩壁方向。陈默顺着她所指看去，瞳孔微微一缩。

    在他们前方不远处的湿软泥地上，有两行清晰的、新的脚印。脚印颇大，入泥颇深，显然属于成年男子，且不止一人。脚印有些凌乱，方向正是朝着那片藤蔓遮掩的岩壁而去，而且……其中一行脚印，似乎有些拖沓，步幅不稳，看起来像是腿脚不便的样子。

    王炎？陈默脑海中瞬间闪过这个名字。王炎的右腿被他用柴刀掷伤，若未完全恢复，走路时或许便是这般姿态。

    苏芸显然也想到了。她与陈默对视一眼，点了点头，随即身形一矮，如同一只灵巧的狸猫，悄无声息地向着那片藤蔓靠近。陈默学着她的样子，尽力收敛气息，放轻脚步，跟在后面，心脏却不由自主地加快了跳动。

    藤蔓极其浓密，几乎完全遮住了岩壁。但靠近了，便能听到藤蔓后面，隐约传来的、被刻意压低的说话声，以及……类似铁器刮擦岩石的刺耳声响。

    苏芸在藤蔓边缘停下，拨开一丝缝隙，向内窥探。陈默也凑到另一侧，小心地分开几片叶子。

    藤蔓之后，是一个天然形成的、不算太大的岩洞入口。洞口被藤蔓遮掩了大半，若非事先知晓，极难发现。此刻，洞口前站着三个人，皆穿着青云宗外门弟子的青色服饰。其中两人，陈默认得，正是赵明和那个面色苍白的瘦削弟子（当日镇上三人之一）。而背对着洞口、面朝岩洞内、似乎正在费力捣鼓着什么的人，虽然看不太清正脸，但那微跛的站姿和身形，赫然正是王炎！

    而在他们脚边不远处，岩洞入口的阴影里，蜷缩着一个瘦小的身影。粗布衣裳，头发散乱，正是那个采药的女孩！她似乎昏迷着，一动不动，身上沾满泥污，看不清是否受伤，但胸脯微微起伏，显然还活着。

    陈默的呼吸猛地一窒，握刀的手瞬间收紧，指节发白。果然是他们！他们把这女孩抓到了这里！他们要干什么？

    “王师兄，还没弄开吗？这破禁制怎么这么麻烦！”赵明的声音带着明显的不耐，他踢了踢脚边一块碎石，“这鬼地方，瘴气越来越重了，待久了浑身不舒服。”

    “闭嘴！你行你来？”王炎头也不回，声音嘶哑，带着压抑的怒气，显然腿伤和眼前的禁制都让他心情极差。他手中拿着一把泛着微光的短剑，正小心翼翼地在一个看似普通的岩壁上刻画、试探着什么，发出“嗤嗤”的轻响和细微的火星。那岩壁表面，隐约能看到一些黯淡的、扭曲的纹路，仿佛天然形成，又隐隐透着人工的痕迹。

    “王师兄，这洞里的东西……真像传言说的那样？”那瘦削弟子声音有些发虚，目光不时瞟向幽深的洞内，又警惕地看看四周，“咱们私自行动，若是被执事堂发现……”

    “怕什么！这黑风涧死个把人、丢点东西，谁查得清？”赵明哼道，“这丫头自己找死，撞见咱们在这儿，怨得了谁？等王师兄破了这禁制，拿到里面的东西，咱们找个地方把她一埋，神不知鬼不觉！至于洞里的东西……嘿嘿，那可是咱们的机缘！听说上次有师兄在里面得了块‘寒铁精’，换了好几十灵石呢！”

    机缘？禁制？寒铁精？

    陈默心中念头急转。看来，这黑风涧深处，并非只有危险，或许也隐藏着一些未被宗门完全掌控的、蕴含灵材或前人遗泽的地方。赵明三人显然是知道此处有个被简单禁制守护的岩洞，前来探宝，却不巧被这进山采药的女孩撞见，于是便将她掳来，看样子，是打算等取了洞中之物，再杀人灭口！

    好狠毒的心肠！就为了一点可能的机缘，和一次无意的撞见，就要取人性命！

    一股冰冷的怒火，混杂着对那女孩处境的担忧，在陈默胸中升腾。但他强迫自己冷静下来。对方三人，王炎炼气四层巅峰，即便腿伤未愈，实力也远非自己能敌。赵明和那瘦削弟子，至少也是炼气二三层。硬拼，毫无胜算，甚至可能连累苏芸。

    他看向苏芸。苏芸也正看着他，眼神依旧平静，但深处似乎有一丝询问，也有一丝等待。她在等他的决定。

    是悄然退走，当作什么都没看见，保全自身？还是……

    陈默的目光，再次落向岩洞前那个昏迷的、瘦小无助的身影。又看向正背对着他们、全神贯注破解禁制的王炎，看向一脸不耐的赵明和神色不安的瘦削弟子。

    他想起了自己在较技台上，面对王炎那必杀一掌时，那种无处可逃、只能以命相搏的绝望。想起了那女孩塞给他野菜时，眼中一闪而过的、微弱的感激和善意。

    然后，他想起了苏芸曾平静说出的那句话：“眼要明，心要细，不可全信，亦不可不信。需有自己的判断。”

    现在，他“看”到了。判断，也在心中清晰。
content_en:
After deviating from the familiar path, the face of the mountain forest suddenly became unfamiliar and sinister.
What was beneath our feet was no longer a relatively flat, well-trodden dirt road, but instead tangled tree roots, slippery moss, and knee-deep rotten leaves that had accumulated for countless years.Every step requires extra care, especially since Chen Mo's left arm is inconvenient, his body balance is affected, and walking is even more difficult.Su Yun walked a few steps ahead of him, her posture still light, and she seemed to be accustomed to these difficult terrains. Occasionally, when Chen Mo staggered or needed to climb an obstacle, she would stop and signal with her eyes or a simple gesture.
The fresh smell of grass, earth, and dew in the air was gradually replaced by a deeper and more mixed smell.It was a rich, sweet smell of rotting plants, mixed with a vague, chest-suffocating earthy smell and... some kind of indescribable smell, similar to sulfur but more dank.The light also became darker. The crowns of tall trees almost completely blocked the sky. Only occasionally, a few rays of pale and feeble skylight leaked through the gaps between the extremely sparse branches and leaves. Not only did they fail to illuminate the way forward, but they made the contrast between the darkness and light spots in the forest even more eerie.
It's miasma.Chen Mo's heart sank.Although it was extremely thin, far from being lethal or hallucinogenic, just breathing this air made him feel a little short of breath. The warm current in his body that had finally recovered a little seemed to be suppressed, and its operation became stagnant.The injury on his left shoulder also began to hurt under the stimulation of the cold, damp and dirty air.
"Follow closely. Don't touch the surrounding plants at will, especially those with bright colors." Su Yun's voice came from the front, deeper than usual, and seemed to have been affected by the environment. "This place is near the outskirts of the Black Wind Stream. The miasma is emerging, and there are many poisonous insects, snakes and ants lurking. Control your breath and don't be loud."
Chen Mo followed the words and tried to adjust his breathing, trying to achieve some kind of balance between himself and the uncomfortable environment around him.He thought of the breathing techniques taught by Su Yun. That technique seemed to have the characteristics of "harmony" and "nourishing", and might be able to resist him a little.He tried to run it, and sure enough, with the adjustment of his breathing rhythm, the sluggishness caused by inhaling the dirty air in his body was relieved a little, and his mind became slightly more stable.But the effect is limited. After all, this method focuses on warming and harmonizing, rather than fighting against external evils.
Su Yun seemed to notice the change in his aura, and looked back at him, with an almost imperceptible understanding flashing in her eyes, but she didn't say anything, but her feet moved faster.
The terrain began to slope downwards, and they seemed to be entering a valley.The trees gradually thinned out and were replaced by large tracts of dark ferns and moist, slippery mossy rocks.The strange smell of sulfur mixed with decay became stronger, the air became more humid, and every breath seemed to be inhaling thick water vapor.Occasionally, you can see some mushrooms and fungi with bright colors and strange shapes, which exude an ominous luster in the dim light.Su Yun always stayed away, and Chen Mo also remembered her warning and kept his eyes open.
Suddenly, Su Yun, who was walking in front, paused and raised her hand, signaling Chen Mo to stop.She listened intently and glanced sharply at a rock wall in front of her that was covered by thick vines.
Chen Mo also stopped immediately, held his breath, and unconsciously touched the handle of the hatchet behind his back with his right hand.The warm current in the body accelerates slightly, and you concentrate on sensing it.Except for the rustle of the wind blowing through the vines and the faint muffled sound in the distance, similar to the rushing of water, there seemed to be nothing unusual.
But Su Yun's expression became solemn.She pointed at her feet and then in the direction of the rock wall in front of her.Chen Mo looked along what she pointed at and his pupils shrank slightly.
On the wet mud not far ahead of them, there were two clear lines of new footprints.The footprints were quite large and dug deep into the mud. They obviously belonged to an adult man, and there were more than one of them.The footprints were a bit messy, heading towards the rock wall covered by vines, and... one of the footprints seemed to be a bit lagging, with an unsteady stride, and it looked like he had trouble with his legs and feet.
Wang Yan?This name flashed through Chen Mo's mind instantly.Wang Yan's right leg was injured by him throwing a hatchet. If he hadn't fully recovered, he might have walked like this.
Su Yun obviously thought of it too.She and Chen Mo looked at each other, nodded, and then dwarfed, like a nimble civet cat, quietly approaching the vines.Chen Mo imitated her example, tried his best to restrain his breath, walked softly, and followed behind, but his heart beat faster involuntarily.
The vines were so thick that they almost completely covered the rock wall.But when you get closer, you can hear the faint, deliberately muffled voices coming from behind the vines, and... a harsh sound like iron scraping against rocks.
Su Yun stopped at the edge of the vines, opened a gap, and peeked inside.Chen Mo also moved to the other side and carefully separated a few leaves.
Behind the vines is a naturally formed cave entrance that is not too big.The entrance to the cave is mostly covered by vines, making it extremely difficult to find without prior knowledge.At this moment, there were three people standing in front of the cave entrance, all wearing the blue clothes of the outer disciples of the Qingyun Sect.Two of them, Chen Mo thought, were none other than Zhao Ming and the thin, pale disciple (one of the three in town that day).The person with his back to the entrance and facing inside the cave seemed to be fiddling with something. Although he couldn't see his face clearly, his slightly limp stance and body shape were clearly Wang Yan!
Not far from their feet, in the shadow of the cave entrance, was a thin figure curled up.Wearing coarse clothes and disheveled hair, she is the girl collecting herbs!She seemed to be unconscious and motionless, and her body was covered in mud. It was unclear whether she was injured, but her chest was rising and falling slightly, indicating that she was obviously still alive.
Chen Mo's breath suddenly suffocated, and the hand holding the knife tightened instantly, and his knuckles turned white.Sure enough it was them!They caught the girl here!What are they going to do?
"Senior Brother Wang, haven't you opened it yet? Why is it so troublesome to break the restriction!" Zhao Ming's voice was obviously impatient. He kicked a piece of gravel at his feet, "The miasma in this damn place is getting worse and worse. I feel uncomfortable after staying here for a long time."
"Shut up! You can do it?" Wang Yan didn't look back, his voice was hoarse and filled with suppressed anger. It was obvious that his leg injury and the restriction in front of him made him feel very bad.He held a shimmering dagger in his hand, and was carefully carving and testing something on a seemingly ordinary rock wall, making a soft "chichi" sound and tiny sparks.On the surface of the rock wall, you can vaguely see some dim and twisted lines, which seem to be naturally formed, but also have faint traces of artificial artifacts.
"Senior Brother Wang, are the things in this cave... really what the rumors say?" The thin disciple's voice was a little weak, and his eyes occasionally glanced into the deep cave, and then looked around warily, "Let's act privately, if we are discovered by the Deacon Hall..."
"What are you afraid of! This Heifengjian has killed some people and lost some things. Who can find out?" Zhao Ming snorted, "This girl is looking for death. She bumped into us here, who can she blame? Wait until Senior Brother Wang breaks this restriction and gets the things inside., let’s find a place to bury her without anyone noticing!As for the things in the cave... Hehe, that’s our chance!I heard that a senior brother got a piece of ‘Cold Iron Essence’ in it last time and exchanged it for dozens of spiritual stones!”
Opportunity?Prohibition?Cold Iron Essence?
Chen Mo's thoughts started to change rapidly.It seems that there are not only dangers in the depths of the Black Wind Stream, but there may also be some hidden places that are not completely controlled by the sect and contain spiritual materials or legacy of previous generations.Zhao Ming and the others obviously knew that there was a cave here that was guarded by a simple prohibition. They came to hunt for treasures, but they happened to be bumped into by the girl who went into the mountain to collect medicine, so they kidnapped her. It seemed that they planned to wait for the things in the cave to be taken, and then kill her!
What a cruel heart!Just for the slightest chance and an accidental encounter, he would take someone's life!
A cold anger, mixed with worry about the girl's situation, rose in Chen Mo's chest.But he forced himself to calm down.Among the three opponents, Wang Yan was at the peak of the fourth level of Qi Refining. Even though his leg injury had not healed, his strength was far beyond his own.Zhao Ming and that thin disciple were at least at the second or third level of Qi Refining.If you fight hard, there is no chance of winning, and it may even harm Su Yun.
He looked at Su Yun.Su Yun was also looking at him, her eyes still calm, but there seemed to be a trace of inquiry and a trace of waiting deep in her eyes.She was waiting for his decision.
Should he retreat quietly, act like he didn't see anything, and protect himself?still……
Chen Mo's eyes once again fell on the unconscious, thin and helpless figure in front of the cave.Then he looked at Wang Yan, who was facing away from them and concentrating on cracking the restrictions, at Zhao Ming who looked impatient, and at the thin disciple who looked uneasy.
He recalled the despair he felt when he faced Wang Yan's fatal palm on the competition stage, with nowhere to escape and had no choice but to fight with his life.He remembered the faint gratitude and kindness that flashed in the girl's eyes when she stuffed him with wild vegetables.
Then, he remembered what Su Yun had said calmly: "You must have a clear eye and a careful heart. You must not believe everything or not. You must make your own judgment."
Now, he "sees" it.The judgment is also clear in the heart.
